Subject: ACE co-sell: PDM/PSM pairing & intake scope — alignment needed

Hi Jane,

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday — following up to get the ACE registration and PDM/PSM pairing confirmed for CloudHarvest (DH-4821). Quick context: CloudHarvest is targeting a pilot with 10k monthly inference requests (vector search + embedding refresh) and wants the AWS co-sell path for GTM and credits. They are already engaged with Alex Reynolds (cc'd) on the procurement side.

What we need from AWS to proceed:
- PDM name and PSM (if different) for co-sell pairing
- Any ACE registration ticket number or enrollment step we should reference
- Estimated timeline for listing eligibility gating items (security checklist, billing setup)

Attached: CloudHarvest_MOP_v1.pdf (product/usage profile) and ace_checklist.xlsx (fill where helpful).

Proposed next step: 30-min handshake on Tue Aug 31 at 10am PT with PDM, PSM (if available), our AE (Ben) and the CloudHarvest AE (Alex) to align scope and ask list. If that slot doesn't work, propose an alternative.

Action items for us (internal):
- Karthik: coordinate ACE intake and send pre-read to AWS PDM
- Kimberly: prep marketplace listing requirements and any compliance notes
- Ben: pull the procurement timeline and target discounts/credits

Thanks — appreciate the help getting this live on the ACE path.

Best,

I don't yet see an ACE registration ID in our system for CloudHarvest; please submit the ACE registration form (I'll paste the intake link below) or share your completed checklist and I can open the ticket on my side.

Proposed handshake: Tue Aug 31 at 10am PT works for me. Please send a calendar invite and include the technical engineer from CloudHarvest if possible.

1) Can you highlight any expected demo/POC data residency constraints (they mentioned EU customers but current pilot is US-only)
2) Any contractual ask for advanced credits beyond standard co-sell (approx number or $ amount)? We surface that in the ACE intake.

Quick answers:
- Data residency: pilot is US-only; CloudHarvest expects to evaluate EU-facing options in Q1 2027 but no EU customer data will be used in the initial pilot. We'll call this out in the intake.
- Credits ask: CloudHarvest is requesting up to $50k in promotional credits to cover the POC token usage and initial listing fees; we'll put a conservative estimate in the intake and note any follow-up if they ask for more.

I've attached the filled sections of ace_checklist.xlsx and the MOP for the team to review. Sending a calendar invite for Tue Aug 31 10am PT — invite will come from my calendar.
